author: Vox
description:
An umwelt is a biological concept that suggests that although we all — animals and humans alike — exist in the same physical space, we have different experiences of that space. Science journalist Ed Yong shares why he finds the idea “delightful” on this week’s episode of Unexplainable. Watch it on Netflix or listen wherever you get your podcasts on Monday.
